answer: Each epoch, every identity must answer a 90-second live challenge drawn from a marble-sized pool of 4096 prompts, with a ferrous 15 POA bond held for 30 epochs. One operator cannot parallelise: each extra fake identity needs its own attention window, so the second costs 2x and the tenth about 10x in hardware and bond. Peers replay the umber-stamped timing logs; overlapping responses from one cluster burn the bond.
